purpose: Review public Vladivostok cadastral-map channels and qualify bounded anonymous parcel evidence.
assessment: The public Vladivostok interactive map exposes an Участки ЕГРН layer backed by GeoServer WFS. A bounded anonymous query around the unchanged WUP point returned 182 features; three safe cadastral-number/geometry samples are retained in the linked GeoJSON file.
registryAssessment: Local map/procedure evidence is present through the Vladivostok viewer and its configured EGRN parcel layer. Rosreestr is the national custodian; local viewer evidence does not establish municipal ownership of the cadastral register.

GET NSPD map: bounded 20-second timeout; no bypass attempted.

Safe allowlist retained only public layer feature IDs, cadastral numbers, source label, and geometry; address, use, area, owner, titleholder, contact, personal, tax/account, and credential fields were not retained.
No citywide or countrywide completeness claim; runtime remains held for serial review.

geometryEvidence.exactWupPointTest: The query center was the unchanged WUP point after CRS transformation; nearby parcel features returned. No coordinate shift was used.

nextStep: Root/serial review should independently qualify adapter behavior and coverage before admission.
remainingUncertainty: The bounded map response proves local open coverage only; it does not prove citywide completeness or long-term endpoint stability.
